newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's King Hassan adviser meets Malaysia envoy.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's King Hassan adviser meets Malaysia envoy.

text.p: King Hassan's adviser Andre Azoulay conferred with Malaysian government's senior economic envoy Daim Zainuddin on ways to boost trade and investment between Morocco and Malaysia, a spokesman said on Thursday.
"The two senior officials examined possibilities to set up joint ventures in the field of industry and other economic sectors in future", a spokesman for the Moroccan government said.

The envoy, who was Malaysia's finance minister between 1984 and 1991, is accompanied by a delegation of businessmen and will meet government officials including Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, he said.
